### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused change preserves existing version criteria, adds targeted regression coverage, and has no identified blocking issues. **0 open findings**
What changed in this PR Fixes Bedrock model-ID recognition so supported Claude models use the existing native structured-output path. **Changes:** - Allows the capability regex to match prefixed Bedrock IDs. - Adds regression cases for supported and older Bedrock models. - Documents the fix in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​test_provider_anthropic.py | Adds Bedrock model-ID regression coverage. | | chatlas/​_provider_anthropic.py | Uses an unanchored search to recognize prefixed IDs. | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents native structured-output support on Bedrock. |

review_comments.body: Maybe it'd be better to change `"^claude-..."` -> `"claude-..."`?

Good idea, done in 4d1e088: the prefix-stripping `re.sub` is gone and the pattern is no longer anchored (`re.search(r"claude-[a-z]+-...")`), so `anthropic.claude-...` and `us.anthropic.claude-...` match directly. The Bedrock cases in `test_supports_structured_outputs_for_supported_model_names` pass, including the `anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-...` negative. `test-live` is red only because the run from a fork gets empty API keys.
